args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed checkout-api running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and error rate 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" for the checkout-api service, describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, error rate down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new/unproven version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback went to a previously healthy production version.
